categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in real estate development, property sales and leasing, construction, funeral services, golf course management, and food processing and retail. It also invests in related sectors such as construction engineering, cemetery development, leisure industries, and food products. The business is diversified across these core areas with a focus on urban renewal, residential and commercial property development, and multi-industry investments.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs customized construction methods tailored to architectural designs and client needs, emphasizing quality control through continuous inspection and testing. It integrates green building materials and sustainable construction practices in response to ESG trends. In food processing, it maintains strict quality control and safety standards, including SQF 9.0 and GFSI certifications. The golf and funeral service segments focus on service innovation and facility management rather than product technology.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include residential and commercial property buyers, tenants of office and industrial buildings, funeral service clients, golf enthusiasts, and consumers of processed food products. The real estate segment targets urban residents and businesses, while the food segment serves restaurants, food manufacturers, and retail consumers. The funeral services cater to families requiring burial and memorial services. The golf segment serves both recreational players and families seeking leisure activities.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are concentrated in Taiwan, primarily in the Taipei metropolitan area, New Taipei City, Taichung, and other major urban centers. It focuses on prime urban redevelopment zones, metropolitan redevelopment areas, and regions near major transportation infrastructure. The food processing and retail operations serve the domestic Taiwanese market with some international sourcing of raw materials.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly midstream and downstream in the supply chain. It develops and constructs real estate projects, manages property leasing and sales, and provides end-user services in funeral and leisure industries. It also controls upstream supply through investments in construction materials and subcontractors via its construction subsidiaries. In food processing, it manages production and distribution channels, sourcing raw materials from international suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include urban renewal and redevelopment projects, land acquisition in key metropolitan areas, and diversification into leisure and funeral real estate markets. The company emphasizes sustainable development, green building technologies, and ESG compliance. R&D efforts focus on product differentiation in real estate design, health-conscious food products, and service quality improvements in funeral and golf operations. It plans to expand investments in multi-industry holdings to stabilize revenue and growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through real estate sales, property leasing, construction contracts, and service fees from funeral and golf course operations. The food segment earns revenue from product sales through retail and wholesale channels. The company also gains income from investment returns and dividends from its subsidiaries and affiliated companies. Its diversified model balances recurring rental income with project-based sales and service revenues.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with other major real estate developers and construction firms in Taiwan, particularly in urban redevelopment and residential markets. It leverages its strong brand, financial stability, and integrated construction capabilities as competitive advantages. In the food sector, it faces competition from established domestic and international brands but differentiates through quality certifications and health-focused products. Its funeral and leisure businesses benefit from long-standing market presence and service innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$24.9 billion in 2023, a 39.7% increase from the previous year, with net profit attributable to the parent company of about NT$1.02 billion. It maintains a robust equity base exceeding NT$11.9 billion and shows steady growth in profitability and asset scale. The company’s financial position is stable with manageable liabilities and positive cash flow from operations, supporting ongoing investments and diversification strategies.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes prime location selection, high-quality construction, and tailored product design in real estate to meet evolving market demands. It integrates sustainable and green building practices to enhance property value and appeal. In food products, it focuses on health-conscious, certified safe offerings to build consumer trust. Its funeral services prioritize personalized, professional, and dignified ceremonies, while leisure operations provide family-friendly, diversified golf experiences. The group’s multi-industry integration creates synergy and stable revenue streams.
